_note: What VidChain must do on every fixture and fault (T6.2), with fallbacks ON. 'untouched' = the current method succeeded in the golden: no chain starts, its files stay the same (name, bytes; the test media are regenerated per run, so no hash), and VidChain's share picker stays away. 'rescued' = a media file the golden did not have arrives through VidChain (the share picker's yt-dlp formats, or a fallback chain after the app's own download failed). 'delivered' = a fallback CHAIN ends with a committed file. 'nothing' = nothing can rescue it: no new file, and any chain ends exhausted. 'either' = rescued or nothing (reason given). Every case: no more crash logs than the unchanged app had (golden / fault matrix), no chain still running after the driver's wait.

reasons.drive-interstitial: an invented host: L only knows the real Google Drive; a page scraper may still follow the confirm link
reasons.cookie-gated: the share carries no cookie and no browser session exists for the host
reasons.referer-gated: the share carries no referer and the page that would supply it was never opened
reasons.js-injected: the share picker asks yt-dlp, which runs no page JavaScript; the WebView catcher (W) runs only in chains, after a download the app created
reasons.hls-plain: the app's own picker (chosen quality first) downloads it, or its download fails and the chain saves the stream: a file must arrive
reasons.no-head: the browser plays the file but offers no download (HEAD 405); the share picker's yt-dlp finds it
reasons.faults: every fault persists for its fixture from the given request on, so no method can fetch it: chains must end exhausted, nothing saved
